findings.highlight: "What do you mean, you're tired of them!? That's why I was against it to begin with. There's just me, Sakura, and you in the house, but you bought over ten pieces of mochi and three boxes of tangerines!
findings.evidenceJa: 「なにが食べ飽きた、だ。言っとくけど俺は反対したんだからな。俺と桜と藤ねえしかいないっていうのに、餅は十枚近く頼むわ、ダンボール三箱ものミカンは持ってくるわ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Taiga ordered close to ten pieces or sheets of mochi for three people.
findings.explanation: Nearly ten pieces of mochi become more than ten.

findings.highlight: "...Fuji-nee, I beg of you, never live on your own. I've heard some really scary stories about food poisoning. If you live alone, you should at least check the expiration dates on food, and be very careful when you eat fish in summer."
findings.evidenceJa: 「…………藤ねえ。間違っても一人暮らしなんかするなよな。最近の食中毒、本気で怖いんだから。食べ物はちゃんと賞味期限をチェックして、夏場の魚料理も気をつけるコト」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says recent food poisoning is genuinely frightening and gives Taiga concrete precautions.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s direct warning about food poisoning becomes hearsay.

findings.highlight: I huff as I turn my away and go back to preparing dinner.
findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と顔を逸らして夕食の支度をする。
findings.governingReading: Shirou huffs, turns his face away and resumes dinner preparation.
findings.explanation: A missing noun leaves Shirou’s movement malformed.

findings.highlight: "Okay. Then I'll just make tons of money and give you enough to pay for all the ingredients you buy.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ん。じゃあわたし、いっぱい稼いで食費いれたげる。
findings.governingReading: Taiga says she will earn plenty and contribute money for food.
findings.explanation: Contributing food expenses becomes covering all ingredients.

findings.highlight: I was a fool to expect sense from Fuji-nee.
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえに論理的回答を求めた俺がバカだった。
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes he was foolish to expect a logical answer from Taiga to this question.
findings.explanation: Expecting a logical answer becomes expecting sense from Taiga.
